title: Need for Speed Rivals

achievements.reason: The Steam app (1262600, "Need for Speed™ Rivals") returns an empty achievement schema and a 403 for global percentages, so there is no Steam list. RAWG lists 26 trophies (RAWG's own percentages): Racer and Cop Ranks 5, 10, 20, 40 and 60; banking scores, a x10 multiplier and Heat 10; busting Racers (50 busts, at Heat 5 and Heat 8, 10 in a Mustang); buying 10 Racer cars and maxing Cop Pursuit Tech; beating and busting a friend; 100 Gold medals; two Ford trophies; and the Platinum. These could seed an original checklist.

game.title: Need for Speed Rivals
game.blurb: Open-world cops-and-racers driving game from Ghost Games and Criterion Games, published by Electronic Arts, released 2013-11-15. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the trophy themes RAWG lists.

chapters.title: Racer Career
chapters.summary: Racer Ranks 5 to 60, Heat levels, multipliers, banking your score and buying Racer cars.

chapters.title: Cop Career
chapters.summary: Cop Ranks 5 to 60, busting Racers at high Heat and maxing Pursuit Tech.

chapters.title: Racing and Busting Friends
chapters.summary: Winning a race against a friend and busting one.

chapters.title: Gold Medals and Ford Cars
chapters.summary: Gold medals across both factions, the Ford car trophies and the full trophy set.
